title: Escort Terrace
description: A Vanilla Plus Modpack with some amazing QoL improvements and slight game progression changes.
body:
![Headline Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cd8e4d986f86e21548504837667adc6fa15eb8fc_0.webp)
### _Breathe Life back into Vanilla_
---
![Overview Header](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dd8973c607985a7b78295e634e4003433b7e0063.png)
Escort Terrace's own modpack offers a spin on traditional vanilla minecraft without expanding too much of the core functionality. From new **farming** and **food** options, to more **exploration** across new biomes and even some expanded **game progression**. Each part of the Minecraft you **love**, improved on without being replaced.

---
![Mods Header](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ff2d38ceb6a401c3a3c2541579a78dd1b2a32574.png)
The mods are a carefully curated list of the best Vanilla+ has to offer, featuring favourites across all of the modding community; all available on 1.21! 

## Including but not limited to:
- AppleSkin
- Better Archeology
- BetterEnd
- BetterNether
- Biomes O'Plenty
- ChoiceTheorem's Overhauled Villages
- Distant Horizons
- Dungeons and Taverns
- End Remastered
- Explorify
- Farmer's Delight Refabricated
- JEI
- Macaw's Doors, Fences and Walls, and Trapdoors
- MES & MNS
- Particular
- Reactive Music
- Simple VC
- Terralith
- Tom's Simple Storage Mod & Trading Network
- Traveler's Backpack
- Vanilla Refresh
- Waystones
- Xaero's Minimap & World Map
- You're in Grave Danger
- And Yung's Full Suite of Better Structure Mods

---
![Known Bugs Header](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ae5a480c74e7b88110bf156e8b374af09470b163.png)
Being only shortly after the first beta release, the known bugs is not an extensive list. But please do let us know if there's anything not playing nice.
What is known:
- Occasionally, you're able to unintentionally move your character whilst typing in the JEI. Try not to search your inventory next to any cliffs.
- Some broken entity textures, namely with Cows and Pigs. (They're overrated anyway.)
- Tick Rates can lag behind a little while new areas are being generated. You may have to be patient sometimes while exploring; difficult, I know.
- Base-game Elytra (and deeper and darker modded ones) make a constant breaking effect when used in the dedicated Elytra slot. It can get extremely annoying but wearing them in the regular chestplate slot is a workaround for now.

---
![Notes Header](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/10b8843273497552e4d5dc98945febb423db2e1e.png)
Currently, being in beta some crashes and bugs are expected. Please be aware of the risk of playing and let us know if anything isn't doing what it should be.
Most importantly, don't forget to enjoy!
Oh, and call your mother once in a while. She misses you.
